How to use this very large guide

This is a very big guide. To make it easier, you can begin with the Quick start section, then learn one of the inductions and the whole return sequence. Then, you can read the Let the next response guide you section, to learn what to do when your response is not guided by a recording. You can also look at the daily and weekly sections to make the practice your own, every day or every week. There are lots of appendices with extra tools, covering lots of topics, including asking the subconscious questions, NLP patterns of language, working with anxiety, working with daydreams, altered states in general, what to do if you experience the sensation of a hostile presence, working with sleep, influence, and more inductions. All sources used are in Appendix K.
